name: Mentholynx
look: a sleek dark navy lynx frosted with mint: frost along its back, mint cheek ruffs and ear tufts, icy glowing eyes, a bobtail and crystal shards along its spine
entry: Its icy breath masks the harshness of winter air, lulling lost travelers into staying out in the cold far longer than they should.
how: Wild: uncommon in the Ashtray Wastes (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto).
It learns Frostbite Drag at level 21.
